# PR #4464: Patch: follow-up to #4419 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #4456

Re-keyed Shadowstep's kept script row from v0.6.9f to exactly v0.6.9g, so games recorded at v0.6.9g (which ran the old any-destroyed-card trigger) fold under the old script instead of falling through to the new Units-only script and failing their recorded final hash (R767000).

Changed files (5, matching the plan exactly):
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c014_shadowstep.rs`: renamed `script_v0_6_9f` to `script_v0_6_9g` (body byte-identical, `scripts(true, false)`); updated the two comments naming v0.6.9f and the kept-scripts behavior test to `("v0.6.9g", script_v0_6_9g())`.
- `crates/cards/src/history.rs`: row re-keyed to `(c014_shadowstep::ID, "v0.6.9g", script_v0_6_9g)`; test rewritten as `r767000_issue_4395_shadowstep_is_kept_through_v0_6_9g_…` using the existing `assert_kept_through` helper over `["v0.4.12c", …, "v0.6.9g"]` with `after="v0.6.9h"`.
- `spec/rulings/R4395000.md`, `spec/pending/4395.md`, and the pending fragment's `notes`: version strings moved from v0.6.9f to v0.6.9g. No new ruling note or fragment, per the #4090 precedent.

How I tested it, with observed output:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r767000_issue_4395` — 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r767000` — 303 passed, 0 failed (includes the params-consistency test; I also verified the classic-014 entries of `v0.6.9f.json` and `v0.6.9g.json` are identical, so the kept script declares the right numbers for every version it covers).

- `cargo fmt --check` — clean after applying one rustfmt line-wrap.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` — clean.
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check` — all ok (2361 rulings, 5935 proofs).

- [ ] `crates/cards/src/history.rs:1180`: Shadowstep's kept-script row is keyed at v0.6.9f, but v0.6.9g had already shipped when #4419 merged. Games recorded at v0.6.9g ran the old trigger (it answered any destroyed card of yours) but now fold under the new Units-only script, so any such game where a Field Spell or Trap of that player was destroyed with a base Shadowstep set fails its recorded final hash (R767000).
  Evidence: `crates/cards/patches/patches.json` ends with v0.6.9f and then v0.6.9g (dated 2026-11-22). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4a7e988aae HEAD` succeeds: `patches ship: v0.6.9g (#4437)`, 01:22 UTC, is an ancestor of the merge dd441f06ba, 02:52 UTC. `covering_at` (history.rs:1425) only uses a row whose key comes at or after the replayed version, so v0.6.9g matches no Shadowstep row. This is the same mistake #4086 fixed for earlier rows. Fix: re-key the row at v0.6.9g (exactly that version, not whatever is newest when the follow-up is built). Rename `script_v0_6_9f` to `script_v0_6_9g` in c014_shadowstep.rs and update its kept-script test. Update the version named in spec/rulings/R4395000.md (Replays bullet), spec/pending/4395.md and the fragment's `notes`. Switch the history test to `assert_kept_through(&[c014_shadowstep::ID], &[…, "v0.6.9f", "v0.6.9g"], "<first version shipped after #4419>")` once that version exists, or else at least assert v0.6.9g maps to the row.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r767000_issue_4395` — the rewritten kept-through test: v0.4.12b maps to its row; every version from v0.4.12c through v0.6.9g maps to the v0.6.9g row; v0.6.9h maps to no Shadowstep row.

- Keying at any version newer than v0.6.9g would fold games that ran the new Units-only script under the old one; keying older leaves v0.6.9g games failing their hash. v0.6.9g is the exact newest version that ran the old trigger (v0.6.9g shipped 01:22 UTC, before the #4419 merge at 02:52 UTC; its snapshot's classic-014 entry equals v0.6.9f's).
